metadata.content: Conor Benn reveals that he could fight boxing legend Manny Pacquiao early next year: 'We can do it, no problem' | Boxing News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Exclusive Conor Benn reveals that he could fight boxing legend Manny Pacquiao early next year: 'We can do it, no problem' Conor Benn reveals that he was offered a December fight with Manny Pacquiao; He couldn't be ready for that but believes talks can be restarted for the fight in the first quarter of 2027; Watch Chris Billam-Smith vs Cheavon Clarke on Saturday live on Sky Sports John Dennen Sports Journalist @johndennen Thursday 5 November 2026 20:24, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Ryan Garcia retained his WBC world title after flooring Conor Benn heavily before forcing a stoppage victory in the second round. Fight footage courtesy of DAZN. Conor Benn could fight boxing legend Manny Pacquiao early in 2027. Benn revealed to Sky Sports that he had been offered a December bout with Pacquiao. But after the rigours of making welterweight and suffering a stoppage loss to Ryan Garcia in Las Vegas in September, he wasn't able to box Pacquiao next month. He hopes though to restart talks to have the fight with Pacquiao in the first quarter of 2027. "He's an all-time legend. He's an eight-division world champion, he's an all-time, he'll go down in the history books," Benn told Sky Sports , before adding: "Another stadium show sounds nice. "I know the Pacquiao fight was offered to me for December.

De Miguel was involved in a collision with FC Andorra goalkeeper Jesus Owono on Monday and was taken to intensive care, after which his death was announced on Tuesday. The Tenerife squad, club staff and majority shareholder Rayco Garcia attended the funeral. Also in attendance were Spanish FA (RFEF) ​president Rafael Louzan, Spain coach Luis de la Fuente, Real Madrid president ‌Florentino Perez and Atletico Madrid chief executive Miguel Angel Gil Marin. The funeral took place at the San Miguel Arcangel ​church after a procession.
